description: MainActivity class for an Android Tic Tac Toe app; manages UI rendering, accessibility, user interactions, and game state updates.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing the Tic Tac Toe game UI, accessibility, and game state interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI, ViewModel, focus order, and event handlers for game interaction.

methods.name: renderBoard
methods.description: Updates the game board UI, including cell symbols, highlighting, and animations.

methods.name: renderStatus
methods.description: Updates the status text and color based on game state with optional animation.

methods.name: maybeShowOutcome
methods.description: Displays game outcome dialog and announces result for accessibility.

methods.name: announceForAccessibility
methods.description: Sends accessibility announcements to assistive technologies.

methods.name: rowFromIndex
methods.description: Calculates row number from cell index.

methods.name: colFromIndex
methods.description: Calculates column number from cell index.
